label: Fantasy Location
description: High-fantasy settings. Tagged 'fantasy' for genre-filtered templates.

items.name: enchanted-forest
items.text: An enchanted forest of colossal silver-barked trees, drifting motes of light and glowing fungi along mossy roots.

items.name: floating-isles
items.text: A chain of floating islands trailing waterfalls into open sky, rope bridges swaying between grassy crags.

items.name: dragon-roost
items.text: A wind-scoured mountain roost littered with enormous scorched bones and half-melted treasure fused into the rock.

items.name: elven-city
items.text: An elven city grown from living trees, spiral stairways and lantern-lit walkways winding through the canopy.

items.name: wizard-library
items.text: A towering circular library, bookshelves spiraling up out of sight, ladders on brass rails and floating candles.

items.name: crystal-cavern
items.text: A cavern of house-sized luminous crystals, their cold light refracting through drifting mist.

items.name: ruined-temple
items.text: A vine-strangled temple ruin deep in jungle, carved guardian statues half-swallowed by roots.

items.name: witchs-cottage
items.text: A crooked cottage at the edge of a dark wood, herb bundles drying under the eaves and smoke curling from a leaning chimney.

items.name: portal-standing-stones
items.text: A ring of ancient standing stones on a moor, the air inside shimmering like heat-haze with restrained magic.

items.name: throne-of-the-deep-king
items.text: A subterranean throne hall carved from a single obsidian seam, rivers of magma glowing far below open galleries.

items.name: dwarven-forge-hall
items.text: A dwarven forge hall under the mountain, anvils ringing between basalt pillars, channels of molten metal lighting bearded stone faces carved into the walls.

items.name: alchemist-workshop
items.text: An alchemist's workshop crowded with copper alembics and glass retorts, colored tinctures glowing on crooked shelves, chalk diagrams across the floorboards.

items.name: world-tree-roots
items.text: The root-city of a colossal world tree, bark ridges the size of cliffs sheltering lantern-lit dwellings, stairways carved along roots that climb into cloud.

items.name: goblin-market
items.text: A canopied goblin market crammed into a ruin's undercroft, stalls of bottled lightning and mismatched wares, coin scales and colored cage-lamps swinging from crooked poles.
